name.fr-FR: Écrits sur les Maximes des saints de Fénelon
name.en-US: Writings on Fénelon’s Maxims of the Saints
name.pt-BR: Escritos sobre as Máximas dos santos de Fénelon

description.fr-FR: Mémoires, préface, sections et réponses de Bossuet dans la controverse qui l’opposa à Fénelon sur l’Explication des maximes des saints (1697-1698) : l’amour pur, la charité et l’espérance, l’abandon, les cinq écrits à l’archevêque de Cambrai, le Sommaire de la doctrine, la Déclaration des trois évêques et la Réponse à quatre lettres. Édition Lachat (1864).
description.en-US: Memoranda, preface, sections and replies of Bossuet in the controversy with Fénelon over the Explanation of the Maxims of the Saints (1697-98): pure love, charity and hope, abandonment, the five papers to the Archbishop of Cambrai, the Summary of the doctrine, the Declaration of the three bishops and the Reply to four letters. Lachat edition (1864).
description.pt-BR: Memórias, prefácio, seções e respostas de Bossuet na controvérsia com Fénelon sobre a Explicação das máximas dos santos (1697-1698): o amor puro, a caridade e a esperança, o abandono, os cinco escritos ao arcebispo de Cambrai, o Sumário da doutrina, a Declaração dos três bispos e a Resposta a quatro cartas. Edição Lachat (1864).

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes de Bossuet, éd. F. Lachat, Paris, Vivès, 1862-1866, in the typed transcription of the Abbaye Saint-Benoît de Port-Valais (Wayback Machine)
sources.description: Typed transcription of volume XIX, pages 005-021. The transcription loses the œ ligature; it is restored by a dictionary pass (ambiguous forms such as sœur/sur, mœurs/murs, vœu/vu decided from the Lachat OCR). Page-bottom notes of the Lachat edition are kept as footnotes.
sources.tierEvidence: Bossuet died in 1704; Lachat 1862-66 is public domain.
